title: The Man Who Answers to a Dead Name — Episode 1

characters.persona: verification clerk, district office; reads lists aloud for a living
protagonist; taluk topper waiting on document verification for a teaching post

lines.speaker: basavaraj
lines.text: Next. Counter four. Original and two copies, don't hand me photostats of photostats.
lines.sfx_cue: A ceiling fan turning too slow to matter. Ninety people breathing in a corridor. A rubber stamp coming down, twice, on wood.

lines.speaker: chaitra
lines.text: Marks card, degree, caste and income, birth certificate, study certificate for seven years. Six documents. All originals.
lines.sfx_cue: Paper sliding across a laminate counter.

lines.speaker: basavaraj
lines.text: Roll number.

lines.speaker: chaitra
lines.text: Four one nine two. I stood first in the taluk.

lines.speaker: basavaraj
lines.text: Everybody in this line stood first in something.

lines.speaker: chaitra
lines.text: Sir, my verification slot was ten fifteen. It is now half past one.

lines.speaker: basavaraj
lines.text: And the list is the list. Rule fourteen, sub-clause three — verification is by seniority of receipt, not by appointment. Sit down.

lines.speaker: chaitra
lines.text: I'll stand.

lines.speaker: basavaraj
lines.text: Father's name?

lines.speaker: chaitra
lines.text: It is written there.

lines.speaker: basavaraj
lines.text: Say it.

lines.speaker: chaitra
lines.text: Lokanath. Master Lokanath. Government Higher Primary School, Nerlige. Twenty-four years in the department, sir, so if there is a query about the father's employment—

lines.speaker: basavaraj
lines.text: There is a query about the father.

lines.speaker: chaitra
lines.text: What query.
lines.sfx_cue: A drawer opening. A register — the big kind, cloth-bound — dropping flat on the counter.

lines.speaker: basavaraj
lines.text: Puttaraju sir, one minute. Establishment matter.

lines.speaker: chaitra
lines.text: Sir. What query.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There were ninety people in that corridor. Afterwards, every one of them remembered where they were standing.

lines.speaker: basavaraj
lines.text: This name is flagged. Deceased-record cross-check, this is a standing instruction, madam, it is not my personal decision.
lines.sfx_cue: The register's pages, thick, turning slowly. A finger stopping on a line.

lines.speaker: chaitra
lines.text: My father dropped me at the bus stand this morning.

lines.speaker: basavaraj
lines.text: Then your father is not this name.

lines.speaker: chaitra
lines.text: Read it properly.

lines.speaker: basavaraj
lines.text: I am reading it properly.

lines.speaker: chaitra
lines.text: Read it out.
lines.sfx_cue: The rubber stamp. Once. REJECTED, in violet, across her seven-year study certificate.

lines.speaker: basavaraj
lines.text: Madam, sit down—

lines.speaker: chaitra
lines.text: Ninety people are already listening. Read it out.

lines.speaker: basavaraj
lines.text: The man named as her father on this certificate died on the fourteenth of August, nineteen ninety-four.
lines.sfx_cue: A chair scraping. The corridor going quiet in one movement, the way a corridor does.
